segments.title: Australia's living naval heritage
segments.body: The case for visiting Australia for naval history rests on the extent of its heritage and the people who keep it alive. That history is loved and supported, yet it still needs more attention. Its preservation faces a continuing threat from people who do not understand its value. Anyone able to help is urged to support those already fighting to protect it.

evidence.note: Australia's living and supported naval history, with an appeal to help those protecting it from neglect.

segments.summary: Australia's naval heritage rewards a visit and needs continued support for the people working to preserve it.
